episode_title: Own the Doubt: What 500 Episodes Taught Us About Accountability, Anxiety & Real Leadership

real_qa.q: How many episodes has 10x Your Team with Cam & Otis reached as of this milestone episode?
real_qa.r: The podcast has reached 500 episodes after approximately seven years of broadcasting. The hosts note that when they tell people about reaching 500 shows, people are amazed, but they credit consistency and drive as what made the show special.

real_qa.q: What is the YouTube channel view count for 10x Your Team with Cam & Otis?
real_qa.r: The podcast has accumulated 1.76 million views on their YouTube channel. This discovery was made while one of the hosts was working on their YouTube page and clicking through analytics.

real_qa.q: What is Interview Valet's role in sourcing guests for 10x Your Team with Cam & Otis?
real_qa.r: Interview Valet has been one of the show's partners for approximately four years and has brought quality guests to the podcast. The hosts state they have never had a bad guest from Interview Valet, noting that all guests have been great people with valuable insights into leadership and success.

real_qa.q: What is the Green Beret Leadership Program's approach to teaching leadership beyond textbook principles?
real_qa.r: The Green Beret Leadership Program includes implementation calls after the academic portion, where participants learn how to apply leadership principles in their actual lives. The hosts emphasize that textbook knowledge is necessary but must be applied to real-world situations, as the textbook does not always cover practical implementation.

real_qa.q: How do the hosts of 10x Your Team plan to improve the show moving forward from episode 500?
real_qa.r: The hosts plan to make the show more topical in leadership by connecting current events to leadership principles, extract more practical mechanisms behind success rather than textbook explanations, and focus more consistently on how leaders at the top affect people's actions at the bottom, using real-world examples and situations.
real_qa.requete: 10x Your Team show evolution future episodes
